message.content:
The cover of TEMPO magazine, dated 12-18 FEBRUARI 2024, features a central illustration against a light beige background. The dominant visual shows three human hands interacting with a large, metallic nail. Two hands are positioned at the top; one hand grips the wrist of another hand that is holding the upper part of the nail. Below these, a third hand grips the lower shaft of the nail, pointing it downwards towards the bottom left corner. The nail is long, silver-colored, and has a flat circular head and a sharp point. The skin on the hands is rendered with detailed shading in brown and tan tones.

Large red text reads "TEMPO" at the top, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. The main headline is "BAYANG-BAYANG PEMILU CURANG" in black capital letters. A paragraph of smaller black text begins with "Pengerahan aparat negara untuk memenangkan Prabowo-Gibran..." Other headings include "RUU Perampasan Aset Kandas di Senayan H.66" and "Proyek Bermasalah Istaka Karya H.74". A barcode and price are in the bottom right.
